description: Claude Code's AskUserQuestion with two questions, both tabs answered (☒), ends on its "Review your answers" screen: each question and its chosen answer above a two-row menu. The model quoted the menu's rows as question.items with no options, so the card listed them as text and drew no buttons. They are the widget's own rows: options, one tap each, nothing in items. Fictional screen (tmux-rc, 2026-11-25).
